comment: Patches for perl 5.24. Currently only cancels the common RCPV_* return_type_override entries that have no target before 5.38 (issue #17).

patches.name: RCPV_LEN
patches.reason: RCPV_* does not exist before perl 5.38 (cop.h RCPV refactor), so the common return_type_override has no target here and only emits a MISS warning (dict lookup fails; issue #17). Cancel the common patch on this version.
